user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surfaces websites in search results in ChatGPT search features.
user_agents.scope: ChatGPT search features and navigational links.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in site's robots.txt file.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validates safety and relevance of web pages submitted as ads.
user_agents.scope: Only visits landing pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web content to train generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Content that may be used to train generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in site's robots.txt file.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Executes user-initiated actions in ChatGPT, Custom GPTs, and GPT Actions.
user_agents.scope: Web pages visited upon user request; not used for automatic crawling.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply as requests are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content that could potentially contribute to training generative AI models.
user_agents.scope: Enhances utility and safety of generative AI models by gathering public web content for training.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for ClaudeBot in robots.txt to exclude future materials from training.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites to retrieve web content at users' direction during queries.
user_agents.scope: Supports Claude AI users by accessing websites in response to user questions.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-User in robots.txt to prevent retrieving content for user queries.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates and analyzes online content to improve search result quality.
user_agents.scope: Analyzes online content to enhance the relevance and accuracy of search responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow directive for Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt to prevent indexing for search optimization.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for building Google search indexes, Discover, and other Google Search features.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Video mode, and Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Use robots.txt with User-agent: Googlebot and disallow rules.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawls images, logos, and favicons for Google products.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Video mode, and features in Google Search presenting images.
user_agents.opt_out: Use robots.txt with User-agent: Googlebot-Image or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawls video-related content.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and other products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Use robots.txt with User-agent: Googlebot-Video or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawls news content for Google News.
user_agents.scope: Google News product, including news.google.com and the Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Use robots.txt with User-agent: Googlebot-News or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for Google Shopping surfaces.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping, including the Shopping tab in Google Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Use robots.txt with User-agent: Storebot-Google and disallow rules.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Executes testing via tools like Rich Result Test and URL inspection.
user_agents.scope: Search testing tools such as Rich Result Test and URL inspection in Search Console.
user_agents.opt_out: Use robots.txt with User-agent: Google-InspectionTool or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible content for product teams and internal R&D.
user_agents.scope: Generic crawling across various Google product teams; does not affect any specific product.
user_agents.opt_out: Use robots.txt with User-agent: GoogleOther and disallow rules.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible image URLs.
user_agents.scope: Optimized version of GoogleOther for fetching images; does not affect a specific product.
user_agents.opt_out: Use robots.txt with User-agent: GoogleOther-Image or GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible video URLs.
user_agents.scope: Optimized version of GoogleOther for fetching videos; does not affect a specific product.
user_agents.opt_out: Use robots.txt with User-agent: GoogleOther-Video or GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Executes site owner requested crawls for Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Vertex AI Agents crawls requested by site owners; no effect on Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Use robots.txt with User-agent: Google-CloudVertexBot or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls use of crawled site content for Gemini training and grounding.
user_agents.scope: Training future Gemini models and grounding in Gemini Apps and Vertex AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Use robots.txt with User-agent: Google-Extended and disallow rules.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes internet information automatically to deliver search experience.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes information from the internet in response to user requests.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search technology across Spotlight, Siri, Safari, and generative AI features.
user_agents.scope: Crawl and index web content for Apple search and foundation model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls training of Apple foundation models for generative AI features.
user_agents.scope: Controls usage of crawled data for generative AI training without crawling webpages directly.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Only crawls URLs associated with registered Apple Podcasts content.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content of apps or websites shared across Meta's family of apps.
user_agents.scope: Content shared on Meta apps like Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt, but may bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Public online content to enhance relevance and accuracy of Meta AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule for the crawler in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web to improve advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Web content for advertising and business-related products and services.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent: meta-externalads.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web for training foundation AI models or improving products by indexing.
user_agents.scope: Web content for training foundation AI models or product improvement via indexing.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt using User-agent: meta-externalagent.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request and evaluates agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Individual links requested by users and website navigation for completing user tasks.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt rules because fetches are requested by the user.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improve products and services and train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content to provide accurate information and train AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Amazonbot in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improve search experiences in Amazon products and services.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content for search experiences like Alexa, excluding generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Amzn-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Supports user actions such as responding to Alexa queries.
user_agents.scope: Fetches live web information on user's behalf, excluding generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives because actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Automated web crawler providing a copy of the Internet for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Randomly selected subset sample of the web for open data research.
user_agents.opt_out: Set Disallow: / for User-agent CCBot in robots.txt or request addition to opt-out registry.
